title: 2008 AMC 8 Problem 25
statement: Margie’s winning art design is shown. The smallest circle has radius \(2\) inches, with each successive circle’s radius increasing by \(2\) inches. Approximately what percent of the design is shaded?

solutions.text:
The largest circle has radius \(12\), so the entire design has area \(12^2\pi=144\pi\).

The shaded parts have areas \(2^2\pi=4\pi\), \((6^2-4^2)\pi=20\pi\), and \((10^2-8^2)\pi=36\pi\).

The total shaded area is \(4\pi+20\pi+36\pi=60\pi\), so the shaded fraction is \(\dfrac{60\pi}{144\pi}=\dfrac{5}{12}\), which is about \(42\%\).

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: The total design area is the area of the largest circle.
The shaded regions are alternating disks or annuli with radii increasing by \(2.\)
